deploy-bot: [START] Sandbox deploy initiated for tag redwood/api@v1.23.0-rc4 by kenji. Commit: a1b2c3d4. Target: sandbox-3 (us-west-2). Strategy: parallel rollout, pods=4. :rocket:
kenji: kicking this off now, will watch the rollout. ping me if anything flaps.
maria: ETA for smoke tests? planning to run post-deploy tests at +5m.
sophie: I'll queue the smoke suite once healthchecks are green. @maria can you cover NLU smoke?
deploy-bot: image pull complete on 4/4 pods. starting pre-rollout hooks.
jack: seeing one pre-hook timeout on pod-2 but it's retrying.
deploy-bot: pre-rollout hooks succeeded. applying DB migrations (safe mode).
kenji: note — this includes the token-caching tweak. watch inference latencies for first 1000 requests.
maria: running smoke now: `curl -sS -X POST https://sandbox.api.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
sophie: healthchecks: 3/3 passing, /health latencies 20-40ms.
deploy-bot: migrations applied, traffic shifted to new pods (50%->100%).
jack: quick sanity: logs show 200 for 10/10 requests. no obvious errors.
kenji: thumbs up. keeping canary pinned to v1.23.0-rc4 for 30m, then promote to staging if no regressions. :thumbsup:
maria: smoke results attached to CI run: https://ci.company/runs/2248 — NLU smoke passed, tokenization latency within expected bounds.
sophie: perf check: p99 inference up ~7ms vs previous (acceptable). I'll open a perf note in the release doc.
deploy-bot: [FINISH] Sandbox deploy complete for redwood/api@v1.23.0-rc4. Duration: 4m36s. Release note: https://docs.internal/releases/v1.23.0-rc4.
kenji: leaving the rollout pinned for 30m as discussed. If anything spikes, we'll rollback with `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n sandbox`.
jack: also linked the rollout manifest and pinned image in infra: https://git.company/infra/rollouts/12345
maria: thanks all — will monitor Raven alerts and hit the rollback if 5xxs > 1% for 5m.
sophie: good job, cc'ing release coordinator for staging promotion. :eyes:
